core_obligations: Retain the matching-sphere classification and Floer-rank distinction.
Construct the action on ideal triangulations and reachable hearts.
Kill the mapping-class obstruction via the Rabinowitz category.
difficulty_reason: The proof classifies Lagrangian spheres up to quasi-isomorphism via matching paths, distinguishes Floer-rank-two configurations, and shows compactly supported symplectomorphisms preserve the distinguished stability component. It then compares the cluster and Rabinowitz categories to annihilate the mapping-class obstruction and obtain a splitting. Unlike the disc/Milnor case, the author cannot assume connectedness of the full stability space, and supplies a separate geometric argument.

dedup.scope: No baseline DOI/arXiv source match. Compared with CP13-AG-010 and sibling CP13-AG-011/012: separate source main theorems for distinct geometric families and different splitting arguments. Supporting classification, Floer-rank and tilting lemmas remain uncounted.
